prose: The New York Times looks at Atomic Machines of Emeryville, California, which trains AI on materials and designs to change how microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) are built, then uses the AI to build tiny physical devices.
The article is paywalled, so only the Techmeme excerpt was read. It does not give results, funding or customers.
highlights: Atomic Machines trains AI on materials and MEMS designs
Aims to rethink how tiny machines are built
Reported by Cade Metz of the NYT
